Subject: Follow-up: Encryption & KMS questions from today's security discovery
Attachments: Redwood_KMS_FAQ.pdf

Hi Jake / Sandra 

Thanks for taking the time today  great to learn more about FinBank's security and compliance requirements. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report available under NDA). We can share the latest report (SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf) and a control matrix mapping if helpful.
- We support GDPR controls and data processing addenda; HIPAA-supported deployments are available via a BAA for Dedicated or Private deployments.

2) Encryption (at-rest / in-transit)
- In-transit: all API traffic uses TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers.
- At-rest: data is encrypted at rest by default with cloud-managed keys.
- Customer-managed keys (CMK / CMEK): supported for Dedicated and Private deployments (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault integrations). For hosted/shared endpoints we offer envelope encryption patterns and can discuss a pilot for CMEK depending on volume and contractual terms.
- HSM: HSM-backed key storage is supported for Private/on-prem deployments; for Dedicated we can enable HSM-backed KMS depending on cloud provider options and the contractual model.

3) Other items you raised
- Embeddings/tokenization: embedding vectors can be treated as customer data and are encrypted at rest. We can discuss tokenization/field-level encryption patterns during a technical deep dive.
- Audit logs: per-request tracing and audit logs are available for Dedicated and Private; hosted customers can receive aggregated logs or configure log-forwarding for supported plans.

Next steps
- I attached a short KMS FAQ that addresses common CMK/HSM questions.
- We can initiate your vendor security questionnaire (please give us the preferred format  XLSX/Doc/Confluence).
- Marissa (security lead) and Neha (solutions engineer) are looped in to answer technical follow-ups and schedule a security deep-dive next week.

Would you like us to start by (A) sharing the SOC 2 report under NDA, or (B) we can start filling your vendor security questionnaire?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Jake  quick answers and proposed plan: 

Answers:
- CMEK availability: CMEK/CUSTOMER-MANAGED KEYS are fully supported for Dedicated and Private deployments today (AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault). For the hosted public API, we currently use Redwood-managed keys by default. We do offer a limited pilot for CMEK on hosted for enterprise customers under contract (requires networking isolation + contractual terms). If CMEK for the hosted API is a hard requirement, we typically recommend Dedicated or Private for production-grade key isolation.

- HSM: HSM-backed KMS is supported for Private/on-prem deployments. For Dedicated deployments on cloud providers, HSM-backed options depend on the cloud KMS offering (e.g., AWS CloudHSM + custom integration)  we can enable HSM-backed keys for Dedicated when the customer's cloud account supports it and depending on the contract.

- Embeddings / field-level encryption: We do not currently provide automatic PII tokenization of text inputs, but we support customer-side tokenization workflows and field-level encryption patterns (you can encrypt sensitive fields prior to sending). We can also discuss an ingestion-side transform running in Private/Dedicated to perform tokenization before storage.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll upload the SOC 2 report under NDA (Marissa will coordinate).
2) We've attached a vendor questionnaire template  if you share your FinBank XLSX we can start populating the obvious fields and return the first pass by end of week.
3) Schedule a 45-minute security deep-dive with Marissa + our infra security engineer (suggested slots: Tue/Wed next week).

If you want, we can start by filling the questionnaire and include a short technical appendix about CMEK and HSM options tailored to your cloud provider.

Best,

Hi Jake / Sandra 

Following up with the artifacts and a few technical clarifications: 

1) SOC 2
- Attached: SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf. We can sign an NDA if your legal requires it prior to sharing; if so, please share and we'll return executed NDA quickly.

2) CMEK / HSM specifics
- Hosted/public API: keys are Redwood-managed by default; we do not currently surface per-customer HSM-backed CMEK on the shared hosted tier.
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed keys via CMEK (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault). HSM-backed keys are supported in Dedicated when configured to use the customer's cloud KMS backed by HSM (e.g., AWS CloudHSM)  this requires the customer's cloud account to provision the HSM-backed KMS and appropriate IAM roles; we integrate with the customer's KMS using a least-privilege role.
- Private / on-prem: full support for HSM-backed key storage and customer-side KMS/HSM integration; keys never leave customer control in those deployments.

3) Embeddings and PII
- Embedding vectors are encrypted at rest. If you require field-level tokenization or deterministic encryption, we recommend pre-processing in your environment (we can provide a lightweight transform/SDK for this). For Dedicated/Private we can optionally run ingestion transforms inside the deployment to remove or pseudonymize PII before storage.

4) Vendor questionnaire
- Attached is a first-pass of the questionnaire (Vendor_Questionnaire_FinBank_P1.xlsx) with answers to the administrative/security questions. Please review and flag any items that need more detail; we'll iterate.

Next step: happy to schedule a 45-minute technical session to walk through the questionnaire and CMEK/HSM integration specifics. Camila / Neha  can you propose times?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
